hero.lead: we build the website, and the software behind it. so the work stops living in spreadsheets, inboxes and someone’s head.

problems.title: the usual mess
problems.sub: none of it is broken enough to fix this week. all of it costs hours every week.

items.title: orders live in a spreadsheet
items.body: someone copies every order into a sheet, every day. it works until they're off sick.

items.title: payments don't talk to the store
items.body: the customer pays then you mark the order paid. multiple tabs for one sale.

items.title: leads sit in an inbox
items.body: the contact form works. nobody opens the inbox until thursday.

build.title: what we build
build.sub: websites, automations and small tools that do a job so a person doesn’t have to. here’s what we build, and what we turn down.

items.title: websites and apps
items.body: stores, booking pages, order forms, customer portals. built to take orders and leads, not just sit there looking nice.

items.title: payments and checkout
items.body: connect a local gateway to shopify, woocommerce or your own store. orders mark themselves paid.

items.title: automations
items.body: when something happens in one tool, the next thing happens in another. orders into your sheet, leads to the right person, stock levels that stay true.

items.title: scheduled jobs and scrapers
items.body: price checks, report pulls, anything that should run at 6am without you.

items.title: browser extensions and internal tools
items.body: small tools that live in the tab your team already works in, or an admin page that replaces the shared spreadsheet.

items.title: dashboards
items.body: the five numbers you check every morning, on one page.

no.title: redesigns on their own
no.body: a new look doesn't remove any manual work.

no.title: projects that need a 40-page spec first
no.body: we'd rather start with one call and one task.

no.title: work nobody on your side will own
no.body: someone has to use it after we leave.

steps.title: watch the task
steps.body: one call. we see how it's done today, who does it, and where it goes wrong.

steps.title: we build and test it
steps.body: we build what you signed off on, then run it on your real orders and forms before it goes live. not made-up ones.

steps.title: hand it over
steps.body: code, docs and a log you can read. you own all of it.

testimonials.title: happy clients
testimonials.sub: what people say after the manual work is gone.

items.quote: orders used to be copied into a sheet by hand every evening. now they just show up, already paid. i forgot that task existed.
items.name: client name

items.quote: he asked to watch us do the task before writing anything. the result matched how we actually work, not how we thought we did.
items.name: client name

items.quote: when a payment callback failed we got a plain message saying what happened and what to do. no guessing, no digging through logs.
items.name: client name

items.a: a fixed price per project, quoted after the first call. no hourly surprises and no retainer unless you ask for one.
most single automations take one to three weeks. bigger integrations take longer, and we say so before you pay anything.
next.js, node, python, and whatever your store already runs on. we don't rebuild things that work.
you do. repo, docs and credentials are handed over at the end.
every run writes a log. failures send a plain message saying what failed and what to do about it.

items.q: do you work with clients outside bangladesh?
items.a: yes. calls on meet or whatsapp, invoices in usd or bdt.

cta.title: send us the task you hate most.
cta.body: a few lines is enough. we reply within one working day.
